map.每月定期测试烟雾报警器是否正常工作。按下测试按钮，计时15秒，记录自检结果，保障: Test monthly whether the smoke alarm works normally. Press the test button, time 15 seconds, record the self-check result, to safeguard home fire safety.
map.烟雾报警器每月自检一次：按住测试键 15 秒，报警器应发出不低于 85 dB 的: Smoke alarms self-check monthly: hold the test key for 15 seconds, the alarm should emit a sound no lower than 85 dB; if silent or significantly weaker, it indicates low battery or sensor failure, and the battery or whole unit must be replaced; photoelectric alarms last about 8-10 years, ionization about 5-8 years, and must be replaced as a whole upon expiry; annual-check coverage = completed checks ÷ total to-be-checked × 100%, and check records are recommended to be archived monthly.
map.准备就绪 — 按下报警器测试按钮后点击\"开始计时\": Ready - after pressing the alarm test button, click 'Start Timing'
map.每月至少测试一次每个报警器。: Test each alarm at least once a month.
map.每年更换一次电池（建议春秋换季时）。: Replace batteries once a year (recommended at spring/autumn season change).
map.烟雾报警器一般寿命8-10年，到期需整体更换。: Smoke alarms generally last 8-10 years and need whole-unit replacement upon expiry.
map.每层楼、每个卧室外、厨房附近（距烹饪区至少3米）都应安装。: Install on each floor, outside each bedroom, and near the kitchen (at least 3 m from the cooking area).
map.对阴燃烟雾敏感，适合卧室、客厅，误报率低: Sensitive to smoldering smoke, suitable for bedroom and living room, low false-alarm rate
map.对明火烟雾敏感，响应快，适合厨房附近: Sensitive to open-flame smoke, fast response, suitable near kitchen
map.同时具备光电和离子传感，覆盖面广: Has both photoelectric and ionization sensing, wide coverage
map.同时检测烟雾和CO，适合有燃气设备的区域: Detects both smoke and CO, suitable for areas with gas equipment
map.检查是否距厨房/浴室太近，清洁传感器灰尘: Check if too close to kitchen/bathroom, clean sensor dust
map.检查电池电量、传感器是否过期，及时更换: Check battery level and whether the sensor is expired, replace promptly
map.通常是电池电量低的提示，立即更换电池: Usually a low-battery hint, replace the battery immediately
map.清洁后仍无反应需更换报警器: If still no response after cleaning, the alarm needs replacement
map.烹饪产生的油烟可能触发误报，不要因此拆除电池。如频繁误报，考虑将报警器移远烹饪区: Cooking oil smoke may trigger false alarms; do not remove the battery because of this. If false alarms are frequent, consider moving the alarm away from the cooking area or switching to photoelectric.
map.烟雾报警器自检计时器帮助你定期测试家中烟雾报警器的工作状态，记录测试历史，保障家: The smoke alarm self-check timer helps you periodically test the working status of home smoke alarms, record test history and safeguard home fire safety.
map.📚 深度解析：烟雾报警器自检计时器: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Smoke Alarm Self-Check Timer
map.家庭每月消防自检：按步骤按下测试键、计时 15 秒并记录每只报警器的状态。: Household monthly fire self-check: press the test key step by step, time 15 seconds and record each alarm's status.
map.房东或物业对多户或多层建筑的报警器批量测试，逐只标记通过或失败。: Landlords or property managers batch-test alarms in multi-unit or multi-story buildings, marking each pass or fail.
map.新装报警器验收时，用计时器确认鸣响持续性与停止响应是否正常。: When accepting newly installed alarms, use the timer to confirm whether the ringing persistence and stop response are normal.
map.八步流程：① 通知家人测试声音会很响；② 走到报警器下方找到 Test 测试按钮: Eight-step process: 1) notify family the test sound will be loud; 2) walk under the alarm and find the Test button; 3) hold the button until the alarm sounds; 4) after confirming normal sound, click 'Start Timing'; 5) keep holding 15 seconds to confirm continuous sounding; 6) release the button, the alarm should stop immediately; 7) if it does not sound or keeps sounding after release, mark 'Test failed'; 8) record the result and move to the next one. The timer helps objectively judge whether 'continuous sound for 15 seconds' and the stop response meet the standard.
map.报警器靠电池供电、长期不动易因电池耗尽或积尘失效；月度测试能在关键时刻失灵前发现: Alarms are battery-powered; long idle easily fails from battery drain or dust; monthly testing catches problems before failure at critical moments, and is the most basic and effective home-fire preventive measure.
map.测试时一直响、按停不下来怎么办？: What if it keeps ringing during the test and won't stop?
map.先松开测试键；若仍持续鸣响，多为电池电量异常或设备故障，先更换电池，仍异常则更换: First release the test key; if it still rings continuously, it is mostly abnormal battery level or device fault - replace the battery first, and if still abnormal replace the whole unit; if necessary, remove the battery and contact after-sales, but never use tape to seal the alarm long-term.
